reviews.comment: There are no exams in this class. His teaching style may feel more straightforward and practical rather than highly enthusiastic. For the coding assignments, use Claude to be able to code properly. Grading mainly consists of 4 projects throughout the semester so make sure you never procrastinate for each project and you will be fine.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: GREAT professor. He really cares about his students and wants you to learn. He truly wants you to succeed outside of class, so he teaches real-world concepts and deliverables. However, this class was rly hard. If you want to succeed in this course and have no Python knowledge, it is totally doable, but you need to put in the work!

Problem sets are hard, but he allows AI. Presentation is easy to get a good grade on. I would always miss quizzes because assignments weren't written in the syllabus and he would post them like 2 days before they were due. If you check your canvas, put effort into presentation, and have a general understanding of the cases, you'll be fine.

Great professor, however the material in this class is very math heavy. 5 problem sets worth 45% of your grade and they will take you hours, and sometimes days. Required to read 4 court cases/week for weeks at a time, so if you don't like reading, steer clear. However, Professor Luco is very knowledgeable and I really enjoyed his lectures.

Took him for Data Science (471). Python HEAVY class. I spent a lot of time debugging and googling how to do code but when I asked for help he was very helpful! While the content is tough, he grades very nicely!

He does want you to succeed. The class IS difficult.. mostly due to problem sets. Find a good group to work them with and you'll be fine. If you're working on them by yourself you will have a very hard time. Case study isn't too difficult. Just be prepared. Extra credit is helpful and not graded hard. If you put in the effort, you will do fine.

Not only is this class not easy, but he doesn't review any of the material on the problem sets, which are half of your overall grade. You're on your own! You have to do a group project presentation- was assigned to do ours the day before Thanksgiving (LOL!) rambles instead of going over class content. I def do not recommend him or his class, sorry!

This class is not easy by any means. His lectures don't seem to coincide with the problem sets, which will take you HOURS if not days to do. They are extremely hard and a huge chunk of your grade. There is a big presentation, but he walks you through it very well and is extremely helpful. I wish I would've gone to his office hours more often.

This professor is amazing. It's a shock at first but the work is within reach and so is he. He enjoys helping his students succeed and wants them to work through the difficulties of the problem sets. It's impossible to take this class and not attend, participation and asking questions is also important. Overall amazing and knowledgeable Professor!
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: You will not need python for this course. Basic Microsoft Excel knowledge would help you. Show up to class and pay attention, and you'll be fine. He allows 15 minute office hours appointments, which don't feel like enough for how you may feel lost on the problem sets. Once you get the hang of it, it'll be a fun and interesting class.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The problem sets for this class are the worst homework I have ever done, he wants students to use Python in the most roundabout way possible. The homework is completely unrelated to what's discussed in class and it's like taking 2 classes in one. Do not reccomend
Great course. Had to work hard but learned a lot.
